change_boundary: Two bounded A2A JSON-RPC interoperability repairs: serve /rpc and /rpc/ through the same strict endpoint without POST redirects; restore an absent SDK request tenant only from the exact verified opaque route binding. Missing or spoofed route tokens and conflicting tenants fail closed. Cross-alias retries preserve exact idempotency, rejected requests persist no event/task/task-event residue, and inaccessible or missing tasks retain non-enumerating TASK_NOT_FOUND behavior. No authority, quarantine, release, task-ownership, artifact-custody, worker-transition, or gate-status semantics are broadened.
